purpose: Relational mapping for the active PostgreSQL API adapter. Netlify uses this adapter; plain npm run dev without a database retains the separate local JSON prototype.

conventions.workspace: Add a trusted workspace_id to every request and tenant record.
conventions.ids: Generate UUIDs and persist legacy string IDs in legacy_id_map; rewrite references through that map.
conventions.fields: Map API camelCase fields to SQL snake_case explicitly. Never serialize all columns automatically.
conventions.dates: API ISO timestamps -> timestamptz; startDate/endDate/dueDate -> date; preserve IANA time zones.
conventions.money: Existing cents -> *_minor integer units with currency. Serialize bigint/numeric safely.

version.notes: JSON format version is import metadata, not a SQL migration number.

demo.notes: Development role switching must remain disabled for real production accounts.

users.notes: passwordHash belongs only in user_credentials. Local passwords and external auth identities are separate optional methods.

authSessions.notes: Store only hashed session tokens and expiry/revocation; normally invalidate prototype sessions on cutover.

buyers.notes: Company/contact/billing profile is distinct from coach-private notes.

cohorts.notes: Assign an explicit coach; reuse programs for catalog cards and cohort defaults.

enrollments.notes: History is generated by triggers. Status values: invited/enrolled/completed/withdrawn.

invitations.notes: Normalize CSV/manual batches and per-row errors. Hash tokens; do not expose stored hashes.

sessions.notes: duration -> duration_minutes; ends_at is trigger-maintained. contact -> session_contacts; privateNotes -> session_private_notes. Resolve missing legacy coach_id explicitly.

leads.notes: Keep contact inquiry and sales opportunity distinct; transitions automatically create history.

subscribers.notes: Preserve opt-in source/text/time and opt-out history.

polls.notes: slots array index -> poll_slots.position; winningIndex -> slot UUID; each ordered choices array -> rank 1..5. Parent plus children must commit atomically.

documents.notes: The current adapter stores private file bytes in PostgreSQL file_contents (3 MiB maximum). Metadata remains provider-neutral for a future object storage adapter; all downloads pass role/scope checks.

reports.notes: type=individual + coach author -> kind=coach-evaluation; participant author -> reflection. Other kinds map directly. Explicitly resolve legacy records missing authorId; never guess the author.

surveys.notes: Question array indexes become positions/UUIDs. Save every answer in the response transaction; free-text reflection stays separate from buyer aggregates.

invoices.notes: amount -> total_minor; simple legacy invoices become one line. payments[] become immutable settled records; derive paid/overdue from invoice_balances.

contracts.notes: Preserve signed content hash and company/program snapshot. Local acknowledgement and provider-certified signatures remain distinguishable.

notifications.notes: Use per-user deduplication keys and read_at.

messages.notes: Authorize sender/recipient relationship in the API; retain read_at.

outbox.notes: Existing draft-local emails remain drafts. New business jobs use transactional outbox, leases, retries and provider idempotency.

hooks.notes: General hooks remain local records. Calendly has a separate verified adapter. Encrypted tokens live in integration_secrets, never in configuration JSON.

audit.notes: Append-only events, redacted metadata, explicit actor and entity IDs.

reminders.notes: Include the scheduled event timestamp in deduplication so rescheduled sessions can receive new reminders.

settings.notes: The current adapter persists prototype preferences in workspace_settings.settings. Normalized availability and reminder rule tables are extension points.

requests.notes: Scope by route and authenticated actor; retain request hash, exact response and TTL.

bookingRequests.notes: Use a distinct public-booking scope and stable request keys.

calendly.notes: Coach-only settings; PAT and signing key encrypted with server GOCOACH_SECRET_KEY. Signed invitee events create/cancel sessions and discovery leads. No secrets in API responses.

zoom.notes: Frontend host connection and encrypted S2S OAuth credentials; meeting create/update/remove with durable retry recovery. Calendly meetings stay managed by Calendly. Recording and attendance ingestion are not enabled.

readModels.buyerEvaluations: buyer_participant_evaluations: roster plus latest published, buyer-shared coach evaluation, including awaiting-evaluation rows.
readModels.reports: visible_reports: actor-scoped reports plus frontend_type and author/cohort/participant labels.
readModels.resourceLibrary: visible_documents: actor-scoped metadata and access labels; downloads require a separate authorized storage lookup.
readModels.revenue: revenue_monthly: coach-only cash receipts/refunds/net by buyer, cohort, currency and workspace-local month; sum appropriate months for YTD.
readModels.availabilityMatrix: poll_response_matrix: coach-only slot counts, weighted preference scores and participant ranks; coach chooses the winner.
readModels.buyerSurveySummary: survey_aggregates: question-level response counts and averages, excludes individual free-text reflections.

authorization: Tenant RLS protects workspace boundaries. A trusted backend must still enforce role and ownership on all base-table operations; database credentials never belong in the frontend.
migrationAuthority: Netlify deployment migrations in Netlify; scripts/database.mjs for a separate ordinary PostgreSQL database. Never mix both runners on the same database.
runtimeBoundary: Adapter implements the current UI workflows. Schema includes additional extension tables for external auth, object storage, complex invoices, e-signing and provider delivery. Their existence does not imply those integrations are implemented. No implicit import from local JSON.
